contents.text: Good evening, and welcome! I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. It starts with a short call with Louis, where you tell him the job, and he pins down the one thing the agent does first. Then you get a working agent on made-up data to look at before anything goes live. The part on your screen, What happens next, shows those three steps.

arguments.question: Shall I pass it on to Louis for you?

choices.label: Pass it on to Louis
choices.why: I take your name, how he can reach you and what you want, and he gets it.

choices.label: Tell me what you have in mind
choices.why: Tell me the job in your own words, and I'll show you how it would look.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.why: The contact page has his mail and WhatsApp when you are ready.
